description: A four-engined bomber with a glazed nose and twin-tail-fin style rear flies low over dark, moonlit water, trailing a faint spray line. A barrel-shaped drum sits skipping across the surface in the foreground, throwing up a white splash. In the background a long stone dam with two towers is lit by orange fireballs and bursts, with searchlight beams sweeping a cloudy night sky. The painting is edge to edge with no frame, border or text.
